name: io.github.GeiserX/vpn-bypass-mcp
title: VPN Bypass
description: Read and change VPN Bypass (macOS) routing: domain lists, services, modes, kernel routes, logs

environmentVariables.name: VPNB_SOCKET
environmentVariables.description: Path of the VPN Bypass control socket (default ~/Library/Application Support/VPNBypass/control.sock)

environmentVariables.name: VPN_BYPASS_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to register only the 8 read tools and the diagnose_site prompt; any value except empty, 0, false or no turns it on
